title: peon-ping alerts you when Claude Code finishes with Warcraft III Peon voices
description:
peon-ping alerts you when Claude Code finishes with Warcraft III Peon voices. Install with one curl command and get "Ready to work?" on start, "Work, work" on completion, "Something need doing?" for permission prompts. Tab titles update with status dots, macOS notifications pop when Terminal isn't focused. Spam prompts too fast and your Peon tells you to chill. Four sound packs included: Warcraft Peon, Red Alert Engineer, StarCraft Battlecruiser, Kerrigan.
